title: A facet is clear only when the effect beyond the floor excludes zero
description:
Feature: Detection against the floor
  Scenario: Floor uncertainty is counted
    Given a cue interval of [3.0, 5.0] and a floor interval of [2.5, 4.5] on the same texts
    When the facet is scored
    Then the excess interval is the paired difference's interval
    And the facet is not marked clear when that interval includes zero
  Scenario: Excess is reported with its own interval
    Given any measured facet
    When the data file is written
    Then the excess carries lo and hi from the paired bootstrap, not the raw interval shifted by the floor's point estimate
